q.line: I carved your name across my eyelids
stanza: They say it fades if you let it
Love was made to forget it
I carved your name across my eyelids
You pray for rain, I pray for blindness

partner.line: Love was made to forget it

stanza: No matter what the time is
But we know it's just a lie
Scare your son, scare your daughter

q.line: But my heart keeps watching through the skin of my eyelids
stanza: All the neighbors are starting up a fire
Burning all the old folks, the witches and the liars
My eyes are covered by the hands of my unborn kids
But my heart keeps watching through the skin of my eyelids

partner.line: My eyes are covered by the hands of my unborn kids

q.line: In the blue behind your eyelids
stanza: Baby, I remember all the things we did
In the blue behind your eyelids

partner.line: Baby, I remember all the things we did
